description: Provider status meanings and Apply Now safety rules. Do not invent approved partnerships.

provider_statuses.active: Approved or usable provider with real course/referral/official URL.
provider_statuses.pending: Application or partnership not yet confirmed.
provider_statuses.problem: Provider has issue such as missing tracking, unclear payout or broken link.
provider_statuses.need_follow_up: Needs admin action before relying on it.

apply_now_rules: Only show Apply Now when there is a real published course and safe referral or official URL.
Do not show Apply Now for recommendation-only courses.
Track Apply Now clicks when possible.
Flag missing referral links as revenue blockers.
